tldr: Moon through the 12th house brings focus to rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat.
body: Moon transiting the 12th house stirs rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat. For about two to three days, emotion, instinct, and immediate need move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a fast emotional transit: it shows what needs care today, not necessarily what needs to define the whole season.
business: Moon supports private healing and release: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Mood-driven choices, insecurity, or escape, isolation, or avoiding what needs care.
advice: Tend the feeling in the 12th house deliberately. Work with rest, solitude, endings, hidden patterns, dreams, and spiritual retreat without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
